{{Quote|The ''Decimator'' may not be as big or as powerful as an Imperial Star Destroyer, but we're still a combat unit, not a delivery service.|[[Pelvin]], to [[Groot]]|<ref name="Missions 9">''[[Star Wars Missions 9: Revolt of the Battle Droids]]''</ref>}}
